task.description: Write the regression test test/specs/ISS-0122.md (spec) and tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig (source). The test must: (1) create a temporary parent table with TEXT PK inside the test's tenant schema, (2) INSERT a row with pure-ASCII PK and verify audit_entries row created, (3) INSERT a row with 0xAA bytes in PK (via convert_from(decode('e2aaaa','hex'),'UTF8')) and verify audit_entries row created with no C22021 propagation, (4) call bpm_audit_validate_chain() and assert empty issues[]. Per DIRECTIVE T-1: real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Per DIRECTIVE T-3 (frontend): N/A this is backend. Per anti-patterns.md: per-test UUIDs for tenant_id; cleanup unconditionally; no mocks; no error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests. Self-sufficiency: if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent, test fails clearly with 'BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set'. After writing, register the test in tests/integration/build.zig if not already covered. Also produce tests/specs/ISS-0122.md per test_developer_guide.md §8 (GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria mirroring the 9-step list in diagnosis.yaml).

issues.description: Test DB tenant_default.audit_entries.resource_id is still UUID; GBL-081/GBL-082/1107 are recorded as applied only to schema_name=public. Migration runner (src/db/migrations.zig runForSchema) silently skips GBL-prefixed migrations for non-public schemas even when the migration is schema-agnostic (uses current_schema()). Test code is correct for production-shape schema; test DB is divergent. Fix path: GBL-prefix skip rule should apply only to GBL files that touch public.* tables, OR explicitly mark GBL-081/GBL-082/1107 as schema-agnostic. Belongs to BACKEND-DEV via ADHOC.
